evidence.title: Motiq - Animated React & shadcn components, installable as editable source.
GitHub - RMahammad/motiq: Beautiful, production-ready animated React & shadcn components, installed as editable source.

name: Motiq
summary: Free registry of 86 animated React components and 8 workflow blocks for product UIs, installed as editable source via shadcn.
description: Animated React and shadcn components plus complete workflow blocks, delivered as editable source through a shadcn-compatible registry. 86 components span AI interfaces, developer tools, collaboration, file, security, productivity, backgrounds, cursor, scroll and text categories; 4 packs (AI Interface, Developer Tools, Collaboration, Data Motion) compose four components each into installable blocks such as an AI agent workspace with run timeline, tool calls, response stream and citations. MIT licensed, free and open source.
contains: 8 workflow blocks in 4 packs: AI Interface, Developer Tools, Collaboration, Data Motion
AI Interface pack: Agent Run Timeline, Tool Call Activity, AI Response Stream, Source Citation Rail
installs as editable source through a shadcn-compatible registry
product states covered: loading, error and retry, reduced-motion support
